entry_thesis: Burlington Stores (BURL) reported Q4 2025 earnings pre-market today with EPS of $4.99 vs $4.71 estimate (+6% beat) and raised FY2026 guidance to $10.95-$11.45 EPS vs $11.9B revenue consensus, sending shares up ~7.6% to ~$323.71. Post-earnings momentum in off-price retail is a well-established pattern, with Baird raising PT to $375 and JP Morgan at $356, creating 9-16% fundamental upside from the gap-open price. The sector tailwind is strong — off-price retail is the 'tariff-neutral' consumer anchor for 2026, benefiting from trading-down behavior.
risk: Q1 2026 EPS guidance of $1.60-$1.75 came in below Street consensus (~$1.82), which could cap near-term enthusiasm; stop-loss at $305 (gap-fill risk ~5.5% below open).
target_return: 10% in 15 days based on analyst PT range of $345-$375 from ~$323 entry
catalyst: Post-earnings gap-and-go momentum: strong Q4 beat + FY2026 guidance raise + multiple analyst upgrades (Baird PT $375, Barclays PT $335, JPM PT $356); off-price retail sector momentum

research_notes.sector_context: Off-price retail sector leading Consumer Cyclical, tariff-neutral positioning, trading-down behavior from middle-income households
research_notes.debate_flag_cleared: Prior timing_risk flag (2026-03-04) was pre-earnings; earnings now released and beat — binary event resolved positively
